column1: # /Graph View (F10) takes the full screen — no control panel at top,
# no status line at bottom, mirroring 1-2-3 R3.4a's full-screen graph
# In READY the panel shows "A:A1: " and the status line carries the
# unsaved-marker `*` plus indicators like UNDO. Once F10 enters GRAPH
# mode, none of that chrome should be visible — the entire terminal
# Seed A1..A3 = 1, 2, 3 so we have something to plot. Dirties the
# workbook so the status line would show the `*` unsaved marker.
# Sanity: in READY the panel and status are visible. /GA leaves the
# pointer on the anchor end of the committed range (A:A3 here).
# F10 → GRAPH. Panel address indicator and status indicators must
# disappear because the graph claims the entire screen.
# Esc returns to READY and the chrome reappears.
